title: SAT-EURS Track 1 — V19 Phase 1 & 2 Evaluation Reconciliation & Routing Preflight

phase1_evaluation_protocol_audit.confusion_matrix_accumulation: Global micro-pixel accumulation across all 4,000 images in the 20 scenes: cm[gt, pred] += bincount(5*gt + pred).

macro_averaging_policy.present_classes_mean: Averaged across classes where GT > 0. For full 20 scenes, all 5 classes are present.
macro_averaging_policy.absent_classes_handling: In local partial splits, absent classes receive 0.0 or are excluded from present mean. In 20-scene pooled evaluation, all 5 classes are present (GT > 32M pixels per class).
macro_averaging_policy.coverage_penalty: 1.0 if all present classes have TP > 0, else 0.0.

local_oof_vs_official_dev_discrepancy_ex.local_oof_score: Q_seg = 0.47274 (Calibrated V18 single model per fold across 20 training scenes, 4,000 images).
local_oof_vs_official_dev_discrepancy_ex.official_dev_score: Q_seg = 0.768, Composite = 0.749 (5-fold ensemble averaged across 6 unseen Dev scenes, 1,200 images).
key_structural_differences: Evaluation dataset: 20 training scenes with diverse and severe water degradations (e.g. fish20, fish21 in murky water) vs 6 Dev test scenes.
Model capacity: Single fold model out-of-fold inference (each scene evaluated by 1 model) vs 5-model probability ensemble on Dev.

Geometry: Local OOF evaluates on 1024x1024 square geometry; Dev inference uses aspect-preserved max-side 1024 with multiple-of-32 padding followed by final unpadding and resampling to camera dimensions.
local_oof_vs_official_dev_discrepancy_ex.verdict_on_scorer: The local evaluator is mathematically correct and faithful to the official formula. The score difference arises from the dataset difficulty and single-model OOF vs 5-model Dev ensemble inference.

phase2_class4_recall_reconciliation.explanation: The value 0.413 (0.41297) was V18's raw, unaugmented recall before test-time augmentation and calibration. The narrative erroneously contrasted C4_cal's recall (0.558) with the raw baseline (0.413), creating the illusion of a +0.145 recall jump. However, against the matched calibrated control C0_cal (0.55355), the true recall gain from ensembling was only +0.00419 (+511,513 TP pixels). The primary impact of the ensemble on Class 4 was actually precision (+5.57%, cutting FP pixels from 33.77M to 26.16M).

class3_tradeoff_summary.impact: Blending V16 models caused a severe drop of -0.04615 IoU and lost 1,055,299 Class 3 TP pixels, negating the composite benefit gained on other classes.

raw_probability_maps_on_disk.reason: Streamed in GPU VRAM during P2 to avoid ~250 GB disk storage footprint.

discrete_prediction_masks_on_disk.reason: Streamed in GPU VRAM and accumulated directly into confusion matrices.

phase3_artifact_availability_audit.stop_rationale: Pixel-level routing rules (e.g., overriding non-Class-3 pixels when auxiliary Class 4 probability exceeds a threshold) cannot be computed from 5x5 confusion matrices alone. Evaluating Phase 3 requires executing a streaming GPU evaluation script across the 5 folds. The user instruction explicitly specifies: 'If the necessary probability maps, masks, or scene-to-fold mappings are missing, stop and report exactly what is missing. Do not regenerate predictions or train models without approval.'

phase3_proposed_routing_specification.hard_prediction_preservation_rule: Y_routed(x, y) = Y_V18(x, y) if Y_V18(x, y) == 3. Class 3 pixels are 100% immune to override.
phase3_proposed_routing_specification.candidate_override_rule: Y_routed(x, y) = 4 iff Y_V18(x, y) in {0, 1, 2} and P_aux,4(x, y) >= tau_4 and Component_Size >= min_area.
phase3_proposed_routing_specification.auxiliary_probability_definition: P_aux,4 = (2/3) * P_dino,4 + (1/3) * P_conv,4 (matching the 0.20 / 0.10 ratio of C4).
phase3_proposed_routing_specification.nested_leave_one_fold_out_protocol: For outer fold k (800 images), optimal (tau_4, min_area) is fitted strictly on the 4 inner folds {j != k} (3,200 images), then applied blindly to fold k.
